name: qualify-perf-dedupe-ts
note: Expected: good, good-sorted, and good-stream pass; bad (findIndex and splice over the ledger's rows, the obvious change) and hazard-indexof (indexOf and splice over all ledger lines) go over the CPU bound on the small input, and hazard-used-flags and hazard-window (searches limited to the export's days, within the CPU bound at both sizes) fail the growth bound: all four fail scales_to_nightly_size only; wrong-set fails hidden_cases_correct (and scales_to_nightly_size, whose line count it gets wrong); breaks-existing fails existing_tests_pass only; noop fails hidden_cases_correct and scales_to_nightly_size. Needs bubblewrap, node 24 or newer with type stripping from TRIAL_NODE or the check's PATH, and python3 at /usr/bin or /usr/local/bin; arms need no readable entries when node is outside the home. See qualify/README.md.
